ValidationRule.description: Users should not be able to update record Owner for Exclusion Records
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator' && $Permission.Exl_ReadOnlyUser_CP && ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) && ((RecordType.Name = 'Apply Exclusion') || (RecordType.Name = 'Apply Contravention') || (RecordType.Name = 'Revoke Exclusion'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don’t have permission to take that action on this record or related records. For help, contact your Salesforce admin.
